svg.aria-label: The disclosure mode of the paper skill. Boxes: The selector of the call: --venue=<v> or --policy-anchor=<a> (the session reads and judges); The session's questions: the venue, for a call with no selector (stop); The venue's policy: you paste it, for a venue not in the database (stop); Formatter: each kind of AI use marked, the statement as a patch (agent); You confirm each uncertain kind of AI use (stop); The mode to run, for a plain request that fits two modes (stop).
